fields.description: Stored copy of the byte-sum checksum. FUN_080303bc compares this word against FUN_08030578(buf+4, len).
fields.evidence: FUN_080303bc reads *(int *)save_buf (save offset 0) and compares it to the return value of FUN_08030578(save_buf+4, _DAT_080304fc); FUN_08030578 is a plain byte-sum loop returning a 32-bit sum.
fields.name: save_checksum

fields.description: 20-byte save header validated word-by-word on load; expected bytes live in ROM and are not recoverable from this decomp slice, so no magic_signatures entry is claimed.
fields.evidence: FUN_080303bc loops uStack_e over 0x00..0x13 (20 iterations) comparing *(save_buf+4+uStack_e) against ROM bytes at _DAT_0803053c (save offsets 4..23).
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Reserved/unidentified header bytes between the magic and the map-id word; inside the checksummed span, no direct accessor recovered in this decomp slice.
fields.evidence: FUN_080303bc checksums save_buf+4 over _DAT_080304fc bytes (covers save offsets 24..39); no dedicated reader/writer for this sub-range was recovered, so semantics are guessed.
fields.name: header_reserved

fields.description: Current map/area identifier. The ROM rejects a zero value and values above a ROM limit, and several gameplay routines index map/sprite tables by the u16 at struct offset 0x28.
fields.evidence: FUN_080303bc rejects the save if *(short *)(save_buf+0x28)==0 or *(ushort *)(save_buf+0x28)>_DAT_08030500 (save offset 0x28); table-index reads of struct offset +0x28 appear in map/sprite code paths (e.g. callers of FUN_0802e158, FUN_08031b0c, FUN_08035e08).
fields.name: current_map_id

fields.description: Bulk gameplay state (party/demon, inventory, flags layout not recovered) between the map-id word and the trailing progress byte; fully inside the checksummed span.
fields.evidence: FUN_080303bc validates save offsets 0x28 and 0x1200 and checksums save_buf+4 over _DAT_080304fc bytes, so save offsets 42..4607 are checksummed gameplay payload; internal field layout not recovered in this decomp slice, so semantics are guessed.
fields.name: quest_data

fields.description: Late-struct progress byte with a confirmed upper bound of 0x47 (71); exact meaning (story/chapter counter) inferred from position and tight bound.
fields.evidence: FUN_080303bc rejects the save if *(byte *)(save_buf+0x1200)>0x47 (save offset 0x1200, max 71).
fields.name: story_progress
